Dear Quillstack Inc. team,

We are writing to dispute charges on {agreement}. Our commitment under this agreement covers {contracted_seats} seats, but the invoice {invoices} bills us for {billed_seats} seats, which is {extra_seats} seats more than the agreement covers.

The agreement states that seat changes require a {increase_requires}. We have no such order form for the additional seats, so we do not accept charges for them. At {price_per_seat}, the extra seats have resulted in an overcharge of {overcharged_to_date} to date, and this amount continues to grow each month until it is corrected.

We ask that you:

1. Issue a credit for the overcharge of {overcharged_to_date}.
2. Correct our billing so that future invoices reflect only the {contracted_seats} seats covered by the agreement, unless a signed order form is provided for any additional seats.

Please confirm receipt of this dispute and let us know when we can expect the credit and corrected invoice. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Brightwater Coffee Co.
